title: TodayWeather for iOS: ad tracking permission
scenario: TodayWeather on an iPhone 12 Pro Max with iOS 26 and Korean screens. The build contains the App Tracking Transparency change of pull request #2949 and was updated in place over version 1.1.1. Korean labels are followed by their English meaning. Captured on 13 November 2026. Outside Europe the steps appear as shown; where a consent message for European regulations applies, that message comes first. Pages 6 to 9 show the tracking notice and menu row added in #2990: the same iPhone, a build of that change installed in place over 1.1.2 with tracking not allowed, captured on 15 November 2026.

steps.title: Read the explanation
steps.instruction: Open TodayWeather. When the weather screen opens for the first time with this version, a message titled 앱이 계속 무료로 제공됩니다 (Our app wants to stay free for you) explains that ads support the app. Tap 계속 (Continue).
steps.caption: The explanation over the weather screen. No ad is requested yet.
steps.expected: iOS shows its own permission prompt next.

steps.title: Answer the iOS prompt
steps.instruction: iOS asks whether TodayWeather may track your activity across other companies' apps and websites. Under the question, TodayWeather states its reason: the advertising identifier is used to show personalized ads and to measure ad performance. Tap 허용 (Allow) to permit personalized ads, or 앱에 추적 금지 요청 (Ask App Not to Track).
steps.caption: The iOS tracking prompt with TodayWeather's reason and the two answers.
steps.expected: The prompt closes and does not appear again on later launches. Weather features work the same with either answer. Where the consent message for European regulations applies, personalized ads also need that consent.

steps.title: Use the app without tracking
steps.instruction: When tracking is not allowed, keep using the app as before. TodayWeather still requests ads at the bottom of the screen, but only non-personalized ones, so the space can stay empty when no such ad is available.
steps.caption: The weather screen with tracking not allowed; no ad was available at this moment.
steps.expected: Weather, air quality and notifications are unchanged.

steps.title: Find the setting
steps.instruction: To change your answer later, open the iPhone's 설정 (Settings) app, search for TodayWeather and open it. The switch 추적 허용 (Allow Tracking) shows the current choice.
steps.caption: Settings > TodayWeather with 추적 허용 (Allow Tracking) on.
steps.expected: The switch is on after 허용 (Allow). It is off when tracking is not allowed.

steps.title: Turn tracking off or on
steps.instruction: Tap the 추적 허용 (Allow Tracking) switch. When you turn it on, iOS asks once more; tap 허용 (Allow). iOS closes TodayWeather when the setting changes; open the app again.
steps.caption: The same screen with 추적 허용 (Allow Tracking) off.
steps.expected: The next launch uses the new choice without asking again: non-personalized ads when off; when on, personalized ads, where a European consent message applies only with that consent too.

steps.title: Read the notice on the weather pages
steps.instruction: While tracking is not allowed, the end of the 시간별날씨 (Hourly), 일별날씨 (Daily) and 대기정보 (Air) pages shows a short notice: TodayWeather는 광고 수익으로 운영됩니다. 관심사에 맞는 광고를 원하면 iOS 설정에서 추적을 허용할 수 있습니다. 기능은 어느 쪽이든 같습니다. (TodayWeather is funded by ads. If you prefer ads based on your interests, you can allow tracking in iOS Settings. All features work the same either way.) Scroll to the end of the page to see it.
steps.caption: The end of the Hourly page with the notice and its 설정 열기 (Open Settings) button.
steps.expected: The notice is part of the page: it does not cover weather information or the ad space and has no close button. It stays while tracking is not allowed.

steps.title: Check the choice in the menu
steps.instruction: Open the menu with the button at the top left. Below 광고 개인정보 선택 (Ad privacy choices), the row 추적 허용 설정 · 허용 안 함 (Tracking permission · Not allowed) shows the current choice.
steps.caption: The menu with the tracking row while tracking is not allowed.
steps.expected: The row appears once the iOS prompt has been answered. It does not appear before that, or when tracking is restricted on the device.

steps.title: Open Settings from the app
steps.instruction: Tap 설정 열기 (Open Settings) in the notice, or tap the menu row. iOS opens Settings at TodayWeather. To allow tracking, turn on 추적 허용 (Allow Tracking), confirm with 허용 (Allow) as on page 5, and open TodayWeather again.
steps.caption: Settings > TodayWeather, opened from the notice, with 추적 허용 (Allow Tracking) off.
steps.expected: Settings opens on the TodayWeather page. Nothing changes until you change the switch.

steps.title: After allowing tracking
steps.instruction: After TodayWeather opens again with tracking allowed, the three weather pages no longer show the notice and the menu row reads 추적 허용 설정 · 허용됨 (Tracking permission · Allowed).
steps.caption: The menu row after tracking was allowed in Settings.
steps.expected: Turning 추적 허용 (Allow Tracking) off again brings the notice back on the next launch.
